item.title: Gift Chocolate Boxes
item.description: A lid lifts to reveal a grid of chocolates sitting in precisely formed cavities, each piece held at the same angle, the same depth, the same deliberate distance from its neighbour, and the person holding the box already understands that what they are looking at was made with care. That recognition happens before a single chocolate is touched, and it is entirely created by the packaging.
